references.text: The description of the courtyard's pillars, bases, pegs, and cords for which Merari's sons were responsible is found in the instructions for constructing the tabernacle.
A detailed description of the courtyard's pillars and their copper bases, as well as silver hooks and bands that the Merarite Levites were to carry.

Earlier in Numbers, Merari's sons are assigned responsibility for the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars, bases, and all its accessories, as well as the pillars around the courtyard with their bases, pegs, and cords.
Moses gave four carts and eight oxen to Merari's sons to transport the heavy parts they were responsible for, under Ithamar's supervision.
The broader context of Merari's sons' service and their specific tasks in carrying the heavy parts of the tabernacle.
